$comment: Species-image identity policy. Read by src/lib/species-media/provider/identity.ts. Each entry records WHY a name cannot identify a photograph on its own. It tightens identification and never loosens the catalogue: identity still comes from the canonical species record. This is presentation metadata and has no bearing on legality.

species:ermine.note: After the 2021 split, 'ermine', 'stoat' and 'short-tailed weasel' name Mustela erminea and M. richardsonii alike; a photo's continent is not in its caption.

species:american-ermine.note: Shares 'ermine', 'stoat' and 'short-tailed weasel' with Mustela erminea; most 'stoat' photos are Eurasian M. erminea.

species:mexican-duck.note: Near-identical to a female mallard; 'Mexican duck' was long a mallard subspecies name.

species:feral-goat.note: Every alias ('hill goat', 'Spanish goat', 'wood goat'…) also describes domestic goats.

species:feral-sheep.note: A sheep photograph cannot show that the animal is feral.

species:new-england-cottontail.note: Separable from the eastern cottontail only by skull or DNA.

species:appalachian-cottontail.note: Separable from the eastern cottontail only by skull or DNA.

species:western-gray-squirrel.note: Introduced eastern gray squirrels share its range and are routinely called 'gray squirrel'.

species:northern-flying-squirrel.note: Near-identical to the southern flying squirrel.

species:southern-flying-squirrel.note: Near-identical to the northern flying squirrel.

species:wyoming-ground-squirrel.note: Near-identical to Richardson's and Uinta ground squirrels.

species:uinta-ground-squirrel.note: Near-identical to Wyoming and Belding's ground squirrels.

species:beldings-ground-squirrel.note: Near-identical to Uinta and Wyoming ground squirrels.

species:gunnisons-prairie-dog.note: Near-identical to the white-tailed prairie dog.

species:western-spotted-skunk.note: Near-identical to the eastern spotted skunk.

species:eastern-spotted-skunk.note: Near-identical to the western spotted skunk.

species:gunnison-sage-grouse.note: Protected lookalike of the greater sage-grouse; separable only on fine plumage detail.

species:dusky-grouse.note: Split from the sooty grouse in 2006; the two are near-identical.

species:sooty-grouse.note: Split from the dusky grouse in 2006; the two are near-identical.

species:white-tailed-ptarmigan.note: In winter plumage indistinguishable from rock and willow ptarmigan at rest.

species:japanese-quail.note: Near-identical to the common quail; most photographs show domestic birds.

species:fish-crow.note: Separable from the American crow by voice, not by photograph.

species:trumpeter-swan.note: Protected lookalike; separable from the tundra swan only by bill detail.

species:tundra-swan.note: Separable from the trumpeter swan only by bill detail.

species:ringed-turtle-dove.note: A domestic form easily confused with the Eurasian collared-dove.

species:cottonmouth.note: Water snakes are routinely photographed and captioned as cottonmouths.

species:black-kingsnake.note: The catalogue pairs 'black kingsnake' with Lampropeltis getula; in current usage that name belongs to L. nigra, so the common name cannot identify this record.

species:american-bison.note: 'bison' also names the European bison; 'buffalo' names water and African buffalo.

species:north-american-porcupine.note: 'porcupine' alone also names the Old World crested porcupines.

species:virginia-opossum.note: 'possum' is Australia's brushtail; 'opossum' also names the common opossum of Latin America.

species:north-american-river-otter.note: 'river otter' is also used for the Eurasian otter.

species:common-snapping-turtle.note: 'snapping turtle' also covers the alligator snapping turtle.

species:milksnake.note: The 2014 split divided 'milk snake' among several species.

species:eastern-copperhead.note: 'copperhead' also names the unrelated Australian copperheads.

species:red-deer.note: The canonical record lists 'elk' and 'wapiti', which in North American captions mean Cervus canadensis. 'Red deer' is Cervus elaphus's established English name, not a description.

species:axis-deer.note: 'chital' is the Indian name for the same species.

species:sambar.note: 'sambar' is also a South Indian dish.

species:ringtail.note: 'ringtail' also names ring-tailed lemurs and ringtail possums.

species:common-murre.note: 'common guillemot' is the British name for the same species.

species:thick-billed-murre.note: Brünnich's guillemot is the British name for the same species.

species:common-merganser.note: 'goosander' is the British name for the same species.

species:gophersnake.note: The bullsnake is a gophersnake subspecies.

species:striped-skunk.note: The established name of Mephitis mephitis; the spotted and hog-nosed skunks look nothing like it.

species:feral-ferret.note: 'feral ferret' and 'ferret' also describe pets, and 'fitch' is a surname (an orchid named for Charles M. Fitch matched it).

species:gray-treefrog.note: Gray treefrog and Cope's gray treefrog are separable by call and chromosomes, not by photograph.

species:copes-gray-treefrog.note: Gray treefrog and Cope's gray treefrog are separable by call and chromosomes, not by photograph.
